Game Overview

In Shark Boy, the core idea is straightforward: dive into "Shark Boy," an underwater puzzle adventure. Master the art of pulling and swinging with anchors to guide a fearless boy and his whale through treacherous waters in search of golden shells. Navigate ever-changing challenges and outsmart lurking dangers in this vibrant, strategic quest.
